actual.value: Project implementation has been more or less suspended through 2024 due to the situation in Vietnam reorganizing ministerial resorts. Only on-line meetings with status and discussions on continuation options have been carried out. Only exception was the Policy Dialogue Mission to Denmark in August. Six high-level civil servants from DVET, MoLISA participated along with a representative from the Danish Embassy in Hanoi. The purpose of the mission was to meet and discuss with Danish potential partners for the third phase of the project. The focus was on education and skills for the renewable energy sector in Vietnam. The mission was rated high by the VN participants, and much input was received for the coming phase III.

target.value: Setting up a quality and accreditation system to support industrial and national standards

actual.value: Project implementation has overall followed the project plan, and due to the COVID situation, we have been forced to move activities from on-site to on-line. Among the project's 4 main components, most of the activities under the Policy Dialogue and Knowledge Transfer components were delayed. Of a total of 15 outputs (the main product of the project), more than half of the outputs have not been completed as planned due to travel restrictions due to COVID-19. Danish expert could not to work directly in Vietnam, and Vietnamese partners were unable to visit, study and exchange in and with Denmark. Completed or partially completed activities are 18 activities that involve training, seminars, and experiential meetings online, or a combination of online and in-person activities.

target.value: Setting up a quality and accreditation system

actual.value: The cooperation between Ministry of Education, MoLISA, the Embassy and Ministry of Children and Education is satisfactory, and relations have been steadily improving throughout the year albeit MoLISA management, has been extremely busy with higher priorities forcing their role in project implementation to slightly decrease.

target.value: Conduct workshops, seminars and teacher training with emphasis on further development of existing curricula etc.

actual.value: Throughout 2023 we have held workshops and seminars focussing on teacher training, introducing models for green transition and quality assurance at local level and development of policies at national level. All twelve participating colleges and their Local Occupational Skills Councils (LOSC) have been focusing on further development of existing curricula some through a so-called DACUM process, albeit some LOSCs are functioning well and others still have to find their modus operandi. Implementation at college level has been in focus. The two teacher exchanges with the aim to show and tell in a very practical form supported the colleges implementation efforts.

target.value: Private sector engagement in targeted sectors

actual.value: 56 Danish and Vietnamese enterprises have been engaged in the SSC-project representing the three branches; Graphic Industry, Food production and wood working industries. In all of the 12 participating colleges, we have established Local Occupational Skills Councils. TC can benefit of this network when it comes to establishing links and relations between TC, Vietnam and Danish industry. Our focus is obviously competence building but the relation between college, student and company is the dominating focus, and in this respect, the easy access to key players in the company is of importance to the trade council.
